## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger and user-visible result. Link the tracker item.

## Verification

Record exact revision/diff, commands, environment, results and remaining limitations. Link relevant UI/lifecycle evidence. Do not use real credentials or private prompts.

## Review and security gate

- [ ] Independent code/documentation review completed for this exact change.
- [ ] Security/privacy review completed; scope and findings linked below.
- [ ] Release-blocking findings fixed and fixes verified.
- [ ] Documentation, dependency/license notices and tracker updated.
- [ ] Deferred tests remain explicitly pending; no unsupported readiness claims.

Reviewer and evidence:

For runtime changes, cover auth/configuration, tool execution, HTTP destinations, persistence and dependencies. Documentation-only changes need a scoped privacy/claims/link review and must not claim a new runtime audit. See [delivery process](https://github.com/mapski/omarchy.spotlight-AI.qsecofr/blob/main/docs/DELIVERY-PROCESS.md).
